sys_atf_test.description: Form-level companion to ATF 11 for the verbatim message "All tasks must be closed before resolving this case.". Runs in the ATF client test runner: the case form is opened, the status field is set and the form is submitted, so the block is exercised through the same UI path a user takes. AUTOMATED COVERAGE: the submit reaches the server, the stored row is proven unchanged, and step 7 asserts the blocking string CHARACTER-EXACTLY against the same fixture in the same transaction - so a missing or reworded message turns this test red. NOT AUTOMATED, BY FRAMEWORK LIMITATION: that the string is RENDERED on the form. ATF has no step type that can read the classic form error banner - its only text-on-page assertion is "Assert Text on Page (Custom UI)", which targets the Custom UI DOM rather than the platform form this test drives, and "Submit a Form" exposes only form_ui and assert_type inputs. The rendered wording is therefore a MANUAL observation: read it from the runner step-5 screenshot, per docs/ATF_MANUAL_TEST_PLAN.md. It is not counted as automated coverage anywhere.
